svg.title: Three reticle families across world interaction and separate UI cursor states
svg.text: I CAN FIX HIM / RETICLE STUDY / WORLD + UI STATES
Three families. The same action states.
Enlarged symbols for comparison; actual gameplay reticles should remain small.
*Unavailable is a proposal. Today, invalid or out-of-range targets return to the idle dot.
No hold-to-interact meter, progress ring, combat crosshair or romance-coded targeting.
A keeps the current game’s simplicity; C gives more action information but needs new action metadata.
